purpose: Optional structured wellbeing activities for longitudinal personal tracking. These tasks are not clinical tests and do not diagnose or screen for disease.

tasks.name: Spatial sequence
tasks.measure: Number of target positions selected correctly after the pattern is hidden.

instructions.en: Look at the highlighted squares. When they disappear, choose the same squares. Take your time.
instructions.hi: हाइलाइट किए गए खानों को देखें। छिपने के बाद वही खाने चुनें। आराम से करें।
instructions.mr: हायलाइट केलेले चौकोन पाहा. ते लपल्यानंतर तेच चौकोन निवडा. वेळ घेऊन करा.

tasks.name: Symbol matching
tasks.measure: Correct matches out of eight simple visual choices; response time is recorded as an aggregate.

instructions.en: Find the symbol that matches the target shown above each row. Work at a comfortable pace.
instructions.hi: हर पंक्ति के ऊपर दिए लक्ष्य से मेल खाने वाला चिन्ह चुनें। अपनी सहज गति से करें।
instructions.mr: प्रत्येक ओळीवरील लक्ष्याशी जुळणारे चिन्ह निवडा. आपल्या सोयीच्या गतीने करा.

tasks.name: Visual response
tasks.measure: Correct responses to a simple visual cue; response times and missed/early taps are summarized.

instructions.en: Tap when the blue circle appears. Wait when the screen is blank. There is no need to rush.
instructions.hi: नीला गोला दिखे तो टैप करें। स्क्रीन खाली हो तो प्रतीक्षा करें। जल्दी करने की ज़रूरत नहीं है।
instructions.mr: निळे वर्तुळ दिसल्यावर टॅप करा. स्क्रीन रिकामी असल्यास थांबा. घाई करण्याची गरज नाही.

tasks.name: Word recall
tasks.measure: Number of words recalled from a short, changing list after a brief delay.

instructions.en: Remember the three words. After they disappear, type the words you remember.
instructions.hi: तीन शब्द याद रखें। उनके छिपने के बाद जो शब्द याद हों, लिखें।
instructions.mr: तीन शब्द लक्षात ठेवा. ते लपल्यानंतर आठवणारे शब्द लिहा.

tasks.name: Category fluency
tasks.measure: Count of unique participant-entered category words; the raw words are not saved or sent for analysis.

instructions.en: Name as many different animals as you can. Separate each word with a comma or new line. Go at your own pace.
instructions.hi: जितने अलग-अलग जानवरों के नाम याद हों लिखें। हर शब्द को कॉमा या नई पंक्ति से अलग करें।
instructions.mr: शक्य तितक्या वेगवेगळ्या प्राण्यांची नावे लिहा. प्रत्येक शब्द स्वल्पविरामाने किंवा नवीन ओळीने वेगळा करा.

limitations: The activities are unvalidated product activities, not substitutes for standardized assessment.
Scores are affected by language, education, fatigue, sensory or motor needs, device, familiarity, and context.
Response timing from a browser is approximate and is not a clinical biomarker.
Hindi and Marathi word tokenization and category scoring need language-specific research before interpretation.
